notes.title: 🦄 Winter Update for My Girlfriend is... Centaur🦄
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! 🌟 We’re excited to bring you the latest Winter Update for My Girlfriend is... Centaur! Here’s a quick rundown of what’s new:

✨ Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed those pesky bugs to give you a smoother experience on your journey through the centaur island! 🐞🛠️
✨ Visual Enhancements: Immerse yourself in a more vibrant and visually stunning world with improved graphics and character designs! The centaur island has never looked better! 🌄💫
✨ Audio Upgrades: We’ve also fine-tuned the audio for an even more immersive adventure—every hoofbeat and whisper now sounds clearer and crisper. 🎶🎧

❄️ Winter Discount: With the Winter Sale in full swing, it’s the perfect time to explore the magical centaur island at a discounted price! Be sure to grab your copy and dive into the action! 💸❄️

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Let us know what you think of the latest updates, and have fun exploring the centaur’s world!

notes.title: Release Day: Embark on Your Adventure in 'My Girlfriend is... Centaur'!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The moment you've been eagerly anticipating has arrived! We are delighted to announce that 'My Girlfriend is... Centaur' is now officially released. Get ready to embark on a magical adventure on the enchanting island of centaurs!

In this unique and captivating world, you will explore lush landscapes, forge deep connections, and uncover the secrets of the island. As you begin your journey, we wish you thrilling adventures and unforgettable moments with your centaur companions.

To add to the excitement, we are kicking off our Summer Sale! There’s no better time to dive into the game and enjoy a special discount. Take advantage of this opportunity to start your adventure at a reduced price and make the most of your summer gaming experience.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. We can’t wait to see where your journey will take you in 'My Girlfriend is... Centaur'. Have a fantastic time exploring the island, and may your adventures be filled with joy and discovery.

Happy adventuring, and enjoy the Summer Sale!

Warm regards,
The 'My Girlfriend is... Centaur' Team
